'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an NPC that first appears in {{Quest|A Blaze in the Dark}}. He can be found sitting by the pool table at the [[Black Alley]] afterwards.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Hubert:''' Colleen is still out selling things. She'd be so happy to see you back in Black Alley.
:{{DIcon}} Have things gotten better in Black Alley?
:'''Hubert:''' Oh, I almost forgot. After Talos was apprehended, the Chamber of Discipline conducted a thorough search and confiscated everything.
:'''Hubert:''' Their original plan was to destroy the Street's entrance to prevent it from becoming a base for criminals again...
:'''Hubert:''' But an acolyte convinced them against it. And I heard the Montelli family also played a part.
:'''Hubert:''' They had people come over for a clean-up and repurposed the "assets" Talos left behind. The things you see right here.
:'''Hubert:''' And old people like us are also given jobs. Sharing the old stories about the Black Alley with anyone who visits here.
:'''Hubert:''' Stories about Talos, the people that came before her, and the dark times under their rule
:'''Rover:''' Remembering the past is important for Ragunna.
:'''Hubert:''' Indeed, the Montellis who came here also said the same. "Forgetting the past will only allow past mistakes to repeat themselves."
:{{DIcon}} Everything will be better.
:'''Hubert:''' A belief that I share as well, {{Rover}}.
{{Dialogue End}}
